verdict.rationale: cubic documents a first-party cross-repo review feature: linked repositories let reviews check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work and flag changes that need a matching update elsewhere. That covers the multi-repository half of the story. Large-monorepo coherence is only implied by the AI chat reading the rest of the codebase, so the story is not completely covered. missing for 10: documented handling of large monorepos (scale limits, cross-package impact analysis), evidence of coherent review across linked multi-repo PR sets rather than only flagging needed matching updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer understands changes that span multiple repositories or a large monorepo and reviews them coherently

citations.quote: Cross-repo reviews help cubic catch changes that need a matching update in another repository. Link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work.
It reads the PR and the rest of your codebase.
